create_scenario_config: create a ScenarioConfig dataclass instance with description, config_module, background_agent_prefab, and num_background_players fields
access_scenario_configs_dict: access the SCENARIO_CONFIGS immutabledict to look up a scenario by key like pub_coordination_london_0
